Sarah, you gave me a $50 coupon that doesn't work.
HD-••••••

Found it and fixed it. The code had an end date on it from our side, which it shouldn't have had, so checkout was rejecting it. I've taken that off. HD-•••••• is live again, $50 off an order over $200, no expiry, tied to your email.

Try it again now and tell me if it still balks. Sorry for the runaround.

It worked, so I was able to place the order.
Thank you.

Glad it went through, and sorry it took a complaint to catch it.

I was very happy to help. If you were pleased with how this went, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And if you're not in there already, you're welcome in our Discord for product news and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

A copy of this chat comes to your email once we close it out.
